summary_md: **LMSYS Org ([@lmsysorg](https://x.com/lmsysorg/status/2115549444724961628))** reports training SWE agents with **Miles on AMD MI355X**: fully asynchronous agentic RL on Qwen3-30B-A3B with SGLang, Megatron-LM and Harbor raised SWE-bench Verified pass@1 from 7.3% to 27.5%, with 3x faster RL steps and ~4x rollout throughput across 384 concurrent sandboxes.
relevance: Agentic RL recipe for exactly the ~30B-A3B model class that runs locally.

media.description: Stack diagram of the agentic RL setup: workload Qwen3-30B-A3B with mini-swe-agent and SWE-smith; RL framework MILES (fully-async GRPO); Megatron-LM training, SGLang inference and Harbor agent sandboxes; ROCm 7.2/RCCL/Ray runtime on AMD Instinct MI355X (288 GB HBM3E per GPU).
